This is a placeholder post so you can see how the reports listing works end
to end. Delete it once you've added a real one.

## How to add a new report

1. Duplicate this whole folder (`reports/posts/2026-08-08-example-update/`)
2. Rename it to match your new post, e.g. `reports/posts/2026-09-01-first-draft-results/`
3. Update the `title`, `date`, and `subtitle` in this file's front matter
4. Write the update below the `---`
5. Re-render and re-deploy (see the main `README.md` for the full deploy
   command, which re-encrypts this section automatically)

You can write anything here you'd write in a normal `.qmd` file — figures,
code chunks, tables, embedded PDFs, whatever's useful for the update.
